1. Vercel Drop

Tagline: Drop it. It’s live.
Description: Vercel Drop lets you deploy a file or folder by dragging it into your browser. You don’t need Git, the Vercel CLI, or any local setup. Drop a project onto vercel.com/drop, pick a team and project name, and select Deploy.
